name: doorloop-mcp
description: Read and manage DoorLoop properties, units, tenants, leases and balances.

api_key.title: DoorLoop API key
api_key.description: Create one in DoorLoop under Settings > Zapier & API Keys. Stored in your OS keychain.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Check the connection and show the key's owner

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task or subtask (previews first)

tools.name: create_work_order
tools.description: Create a vendor work order under a task (previews first)

tools.name: create_lease
tools.description: Create a lease with tenants, rent and deposit (previews first)

tools.name: create_lease_charge
tools.description: Post a one-time charge on a lease (previews first)

tools.name: doorloop_get
tools.description: Read-only GET on any DoorLoop path
